definitions.explanation: The fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans or animals.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}の{毛|け}がソファについている。
examples.english: There's cat fur on the sofa.
The hair on my arms is thick.

examples.japanese: {犬|いぬ}の{毛|け}を{毎日|まいにち}ブラシでとかす。
examples.english: I brush the dog's fur every day.

examples.japanese: {毛|け}が{抜|ぬ}ける{季節|きせつ}だ。
セーターに{毛|け}がついている。

notes:
{毛|け} refers to hair (body) or fur (animal).

SCOPE:
- Body hair (arms, legs, etc.)
- Animal fur
- For head hair, use {髪|かみ} or {髪|かみ}の{毛|け}

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {毛|け}が{生|は}える: hair grows
- {毛|け}が{抜|ぬ}ける: hair falls out
- {毛|け}を{剃|そ}る: to shave hair

COMPOUNDS:
- {髪|かみ}の{毛|け}: hair (on head)
- {眉毛|まゆげ}: eyebrow
- {睫毛|まつげ}: eyelash
- {毛皮|けがわ}: fur (as material)
- {毛布|もうふ}: blanket

RELATED:
- {髪|かみ}: hair (on head)
- {体毛|たいもう}: body hair (formal/technical)
